python -c "
import re

# Let's see exactly what PARSE_RE produces for various inputs
PARSE_RE = re.compile(r'''({{|}}|{\w*(?:(?:\.\w+)|(?:\[[^\]]+\]))*(?::[^}]+)?})''')

tests = [
    '{abc',           # unclosed brace - should fail
    'test}',          # unmatched close - should fail  
    '{name}',         # valid - should work
    '{{ }}',          # escaped braces - should work
    '{name:w}',       # typed field - should work
    'text {name} more', # mixed - should work
    '{hello.world}',  # dotted name - should work
    '{data[key]}',    # dict access - should work
]

for t in tests:
    parts = PARSE_RE.split(t)
    print(f'Input: {t!r}')
    print(f'  Parts: {parts}')
    # Check each part
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if not part:
            continue
        if part.startswith('{'):
            if not part.endswith('}'):
                print(f'  PART[{i}] ERROR: starts with {{ but does not end with }}')
            elif part[0:2] == '{{':
                pass  # escaped open brace
            else:
                print(f'  PART[{i}] OK: field pattern')
        elif part.endswith('}') and part != '}}':
            print(f'  PART[{i}] ERROR: ends with } but is not }}')
        else:
            print(f'  PART[{i}] OK: regular text or escaped }}')
    print()
" 2>&1
